_comment: I2 (docs/BUILD-LOOP.md Step 2 plan, approved 2026-09-08): every export in
public/ and src/ with no real (non-test) caller, at the moment this gate was
built, must be removed, wired, or named here with a written reason -- a
sentence, not the word 'intentional'. Checked by test/deadExports.test.ts.
THIS FILE IS SEEDED, NOT EARNED. Every entry below was written by
scripts/_tmp-seed-allowlist.mjs (a one-time, uncommitted script) from the
gate's own first real run over the committed tree on 2026-09-08 -- it makes
the gate start green by construction, not because each entry has been
individually reviewed. A large fraction of these are the SAME shape:
functions exported individually but reached in the live system only through
a dispatcher table defined in the SAME file (buildings.js's bldVilla/
bldTerrace/... reached via building(), never imported by name from
anywhere else; props.js's model functions reached the same way through
MODELS/getModel). That is architecturally wired, just not through a
cross-file import -- which this gate's simple regex scanner cannot see,
by design (docs/BUILD-LOOP.md Step 2's own plan named this limitation:
reusing the existing parser, not building full reachability analysis).
Others in this list are genuinely dead code, or exports reached only from
test/ (see each failing export's own 'test-only' vs 'no importer at all'
label in the gate's failure output for that distinction) -- this file does
not yet distinguish the two in writing, and should, as entries are reviewed.
This gate's real value starts the first time it catches an export ADDED
after 2026-09-08 with no caller and no entry here -- not from this seed
list being individually correct today.
